notes.title: 0.1.2a) Quadrant 4 Added
notes.content:
Patch contents


Added Quadrant 4

Fixed a minor UI glitch in the in-game menu (no functional change)

Fixed unintended breach effect flicker at the end of a round

Added several small maps to Quadrants 1 & 2

Enabled travel between specific nodes within each quadrant; the links are visually indicated

notes.title: 0.1.1b) Hotfix
notes.content:
Patch contents

Fixed several incorrect Rana's trait values

Fixed the issue that Rana's traits counting stat-reward tokens as items

Tweaked the item pools in Quadrant 1 maps

Fixed an issue where a certain boss round did not function properly

notes.title: 0.1.1a) New Character & Visual Feedback
notes.content:
Patch contents:

https://i.postimg.cc/FRv9H0sG/rana-pick.png
New character Rana
-Has multiple unique traits that interact with the number of items in the inventory

Fixed a typo in the save/load code that could prevent saves from loading correctly

Fixed bug where trait data was not being saved

Fixed error that occurred when downgrading a trait

Fixed intermittent malfunction of item highlight

Corrected a merge typo in blueprint (no functional impact)

Fixed an abnormal behavior that could occur after a monster died on certain stages

Fixed Juggernaut trait (adds STR based on max HP) which was not including the base HP in the calculation now includes base HP.

Trade menu now re-rolls items when Skip is selected

The item reward panel now visually marks items that can be combined

Added icons for stat rewards

Fixed a bug where items disappeared if the inventory was full when claiming a reward


Next patch

Add Quadrant 4 maps

New blueprints scheduled for release within June


Thanks!

notes.title: 0.1.0a) Stat Window · Character Select · Boss Added, etc.
notes.content:
Long time no see.


Patch contents:

Added stat display window graphics.

Added multiple new items.

Added R-key binding (rotate item).

Tweaked several terms/sentences in the Japanese localization.

Implemented character-select screen (slots + preview).

-The new character is complete but still in internal testing; it will be enabled later this week.

Fixed Piercing stat not applying.

Added Traits.

Fixed error when combining three items.

Fixed bug where item rewards were not granted even with empty inventory slots.

Fixed boss-HP UI display error.

Added a new boss.

Fixed edge cases that could occur when the inventory was full.

Adjusted damage calculation for player projectile weapons and enemy ranged attacks.

Cleaned up Quadrant 1 maps, item rewards, and monster tables.

Fixed meta-progression stall in very long runs.

Rebalanced the Crystal Staff item line.

Added new enemy movement patterns.

Adjusted item prices.


Next patch:

Add the new character, blueprints, and Quadrant 4 maps

Thanks.

notes.title: 0.0.1b) Map Revision and Item Type Addition
notes.content:

 Fixed an issue where, when the World Core was discarded, the number of World Cores obtained did not decrease.
 Adjusted the visibility of projectiles.
 Reduced the player's collision range.
 Revised maps where the collision range was inappropriate.
 Adjusted item rewards.
 Added new item types. Certain item types grant bonus stats when placed in specific positions within the inventory.



Next Patch (This Wednesday (2025.03.05 PST)):


 Additional maps in Quadrant 1
 Addition of new enemy types
 New map adjustments
 Addition of new items



Planned Updates for March:


 Adding new items to default blueprints (In Progress)
 Addition of new blueprints
 Addition of new characters
 Completion of Quadrant 1 (with 2 additional bosses, making a total of 3 bosses) ← At this point, the game version will be 0.0.2.


Thank you.

notes.title: 0.0.1b) Map Additions, Addition of Field Obstacles
notes.content:
Patch Notes:


 Two new maps have been added to Quadrant 1.
 Item rewards have been adjusted.
 New obstacles have been added during rounds.


In the previous patch notes, it was stated that a large number of maps and a boss would be added. Although the work has been completed, insufficient testing has prevented these features from being added to the game. They are scheduled to be added in the next patch.


Next Patch (Next Saturday (2025.03.01 PST)):


 Additional maps in Quadrant 1
 Addition of enemy types
 Addition of one boss


Planned Updates for February:


 Resolution settings in Options (Completed) 
 FPS settings in Options (Completed) 
 Key Mapping (Completed) 
 Adding new items to default blueprints (In Progress) 
 Completion of Quadrant 1 (Addition of two bosses) <- At this point, the game version will be 0.0.2. 


We had planned to add one blueprint and one character in February and complete Quadrant 1, but that did not work out. It is expected that Quadrant 1 will be completed by next Wednesday.

The new character's sprites are completed, and we are working on the perks. The new blueprint is not yet public, but we are adding it while testing new item functionalities.

At this pace, the parts we planned to complete in February will likely be finished around March 8.

As an aside, I just realized that I must have written the year 2024 in the announcement all along.
Oh no...

Thank you.

notes.title: 0.0.1a) patch for this week
notes.content:
I initially planned to complete the quadrant 2 map by the end of this week, but an urgent matter involving family business has come up, and I couldn’t finish it on time. It is expected to be completed within the next couple of days.


Patch Notes for This Update:

-Fixed various bugs related to item merging. From now on, there should be no more malfunctions concerning items.
-Made slight adjustments to map patterns, enemy patterns, and item rewards.



Next Patch Notes (Expected within two days):
(0.0.1b)

-Completion of quadrant 2 map (11 new maps added)
-Addition of 2–3 new perks
-Addition of stone-based items


Expected Patches by the End of This Month:

-Partial work on the quadrant 1 map
-Completion of all 19 perks for the default character
-Addition of dialogues
-Addition of a new playable character


Thank you.

notes.title: 0.0.1a) Selling items added, perks added, enemies adjusted
notes.content:
You can now view your Blueprint in the in-game menu.

Items can now be sold in trades.

Flying enemies no longer have collisions.

Damage interval increased from 0.1 to 0.4 seconds.

Added 7 new perks.


It looks like the 2nd quadrant map will be finished by the end of the week.

notes.title: 0.0.1a - Sorry for the inconveniences
notes.content:
Save file structure is revised...again!
(Presumably there were some unintentional save resets until now. There will be one more reset with this patch, but there should be no more unintentional resets after this, hopefully.
Fixed missing translations.
Fixed collision not working on maps.
And a few other minor fixes that don't really need to be announced.

notes.title: 0.0.1a - minor patch) Save file structure and starting map revised
notes.content:
I found an issue with the save structure, so I fixed that and also made some minor tweaks to the map no.0.

The current playable map is half of the fourth quadrant.

I'll be releasing a patch next week that will complete the maps in the fourth quadrant, improve the item reward pool, and allow you to sell items in trade.

Thank you.
